name: St. Clair County, IL
findings: St. Clair County has 820 nonprofit organizations. 303 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 243 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Clair County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in St. Clair County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 177 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 28 would.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 10 hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 76 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
